The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4016 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] between the [[Manderon Period]] and the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Around that year, [[Vici Ramunee]] was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Foe">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref>
